jobs.title: The Garlic Farm: "Shrouded in Garlic" (The Darker Side of Wight)
jobs.clientName: The Garlic Farm × Peter J Murray × Medina Publishing
jobs.rawBrief:
Proposal presented by Simon Harrop (Medina Publishing), author Peter J Murray, and IsleConnect (David Grannum):
'Step into the story at the place that inspired it.'

Concept:
A story-led visitor experience and trail linking Peter J Murray's 'The Darker Side of Wight' with The Garlic Farm. Visitors scan small QR cards at 3 spots on existing farm routes. Follows fictional young protagonist 'Matty', blending real agricultural/culinary farm facts with atmospheric mystery. Drives footfall directly into the farm shop, restaurant covers, tasting experiences, and book sales.

Tiers & Packages Offered:
- Tier 1: Story Test (Recommended Start): £1,450 (3 stops, hero film 48-60s + 3 posts, 4-week trial, end-of-trial summary).
- Tier 2: Venue Campaign: £3,250 (3 stops + family challenge, hero film, short edits, 8-week content sequence, 1 filming session with real people, 8-week campaign, monthly review; optional support £450/mo after).
- Tier 3: Island Anchor: £5,950 (Up to 6 touchpoints + partner route, expanded media asset bank, silent screen edit, 12-week sequence, book launch/venue filming, 12-week campaign, monthly report; optional support £750/mo after).
jobs.clientNotes: Presented Sept 24, 2026. Target launch in early November ready for darker evenings and Christmas gifting, with possible half-term teaser. Introductory pricing reflects reuse of 48-second concept film and case study rights.

job-after-the-rain.subject: Quick clarification on wet surface reflections for After the Rain
job-after-the-rain.body:
Hi Evelyn,

We love the volcanic basalt concept for Aura Hydrate! To get the lighting on your bottle right, could you confirm whether you prefer high-contrast specular reflections on the puddle surface, or a softer matte refraction?

Looking forward to locking this with you!

job-after-the-rain.subject: Re: Quick clarification on wet surface reflections for After the Rain
job-after-the-rain.body:
Hi David,

Definitely high-contrast specular reflections! We want the light cutting across the dark basalt stone to look crisp and photorealistic.

Best,
Evelyn

job-after-the-rain.subject: Milestone Reached: Master Keyframes locked for After the Rain
job-after-the-rain.body:
Hi Evelyn,

Great news: the master keyframe compositions and lighting profiles have been locked. The specular puddle reflections on the basalt stone match your reference board beautifully.

We are now advancing to high-coherence video motion synthesis.

Next update: Initial motion cut preview tomorrow morning.

job-after-the-rain.subject: Review of initial reveal cut
job-after-the-rain.body:
Hi team,

The motion tracking and water droplets look incredible! One creative adjustment for the final 4 seconds: could you make the final reveal warmer and more hopeful? Right now the cold blue tone lingers a bit too long at the end.

job-after-the-rain.subject: Revision Accepted: Warming final reveal highlight
job-after-the-rain.body:
Hi Evelyn,

Understood perfectly! We have adjusted the Finishing color temperature curve to introduce a gentle 3800K golden sunrise glow across the bottle cap during the final 4 seconds. This is covered under your included Revision Round 1.

Rendering the updated 4K master now!

job-after-the-rain.subject: Final Delivery Package: After the Rain (Aura Hydrate)
job-after-the-rain.body:
Hi Evelyn,

We are thrilled to present the completed creative package for After the Rain!

**Delivered Files:**
1. **After_The_Rain_Master_4K.mov** (ProRes 422 HQ, 16:9, 3840x2160)
2. **After_The_Rain_Vertical_Social.mp4** (9:16, 1080x1920 with safe-zone captions)
3. **Keyframe_Still_Basalt_Sunrise_4K.jpg** (3840x2160 Key Art)
4. **Aura_Hydrate_Voiceover_Master.wav** (24-bit 48kHz isolated vocal stem)

**Usage Notes:** Full global broadcast and digital usage rights granted in perpetuity.

*(Pending Operator Final Review & Approval before releasing download keys)*
